body_markdown:
If your brand or marketing team uses Bynder or Brandfolder, you already know the value of having a single source of truth for your assets. Logos, product shots, campaign creative, all approved, tagged, and organized in one place.


But there's a catch. The moment those assets need to go into an email, the workflow can start breaking down.


Your team members download the files from your DAM, rename them, upload assets into the email builder, and you hope they grabbed the current version. Multiply that workflow across every campaign, every template, and every team member with access to your ESP, and you've got a recipe for outdated logos, mismatched product images, and off-brand assets slipping into live sends.


Dyspatch's[Bynder](https://www.dyspatch.io/partners/bynder/) and[Brandfolder](https://www.dyspatch.io/partners/brandfolder/) integrations close that gap. Your DAM and your email builder finally work together instead of around each other.


## **What our Brandfolder and Bynder integrations actually do**


Both integrations connect directly to the Dyspatch asset library, so your team never has to leave our drag-and-drop email builder to find an asset.


- Search and browse your Bynder or Brandfolder library right from within the Dyspatch asset library


- Drop approved assets into your email blocks in a couple of clicks


- Utilize Bynder’s built-in transformations to add common effects to your assets


- Assets are pulled in as live references, not static copies, so they stay connected to the source of truth in your DAM


- Bring your own alt text: descriptions set in Bynder or Brandfolder automatically populate in your email templates when you link the asset


No more downloading to your desktop just to upload it somewhere else five minutes later.


## **The swap-once, update-everywhere advantage**


Here's where it gets useful for brand and marketing teams specifically. Because assets are linked back to your DAM rather than duplicated, updating or replacing an asset in Bynder or Brandfolder updates it everywhere it's referenced in Dyspatch.


Did the product photo change? Did legal ask you to swap out a claim on a promo banner? Update the asset once at the source, and every email template that references it reflects the change. No more combing through every campaign to find and manually replace the old version.


One honest caveat worth knowing: email clients like Gmail cache images to load them faster, so an updated asset may take a little time to show up in an inbox even though the reference itself updates instantly on your end. This is standard behavior across email clients generally, not a limitation of the integration, but it's worth understanding so your team can plan around it for time-sensitive updates.


## **Why this matters for marketing and brand teams**


- **Speed.** Cut the download, rename, and re-upload cycle out of your production process entirely.


- **Brand consistency.** When a product image, price, or piece of creative needs to change, correct it at the source instead of chasing it down email by email.


- **Governance.** Your DAM's permissions and approval status carry through, so brand and legal sign-off isn't accidentally bypassed by someone pulling an old file from their own folder.


## **Who this is built for**


- Enterprise marketing teams with an existing investment in a DAM platform


- Cross-functional teams across brand, design, and lifecycle marketing who need shared access to assets without shared chaos


- Teams managing frequent content refreshes, like seasonal promotions, pricing updates, or recurring newsletters where the same assets get reused often


## **Bynder or Brandfolder? Either way, you're covered**


Whether your team standardized on Bynder or Brandfolder, Dyspatch connects to both the same way; directly inside the editor, with live references that keep your emails in sync with your DAM. This isn't a case of picking a favorite. It's about meeting your team where your assets already live.


## **Part of a bigger picture**


These integrations follow the same philosophy behind Dyspatch's other connections, like our AWS integration: connect to the tools your team already relies on, rather than asking them to change how they work. The goal is one source of truth for your brand, whether that's your assets, your templates, or your sending infrastructure.
